name: vantage-crypto-research
description: Append-only local data collection for Solana token cohorts and GMGN signals.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:ui
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,ui -c green,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.import-dune: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/scripts/cli.js import-dune
scripts.db-stats: npm run build:server --silent && node dist/src/scripts/cli.js db-stats
